entities.summary: Muhiba Muhsinovna Yakubova is a Tajikistani biologist. Muhiba Yakubova was a naturalists & biologists from Bukhara (b. 1937-01-22, Bukhara). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history. Its legacy: Advanced biological classification and ecological understanding.
